title: Filtered chat and timed mute in the Commons
notes: The main account uses filtered chat. The companion is made a game master and mutes the main wizard for five
minutes. After checking a muted quick-chat request, the companion unmutes the wizard; an off-whitelist line
then verifies receiver filtering. A second short mute expires before the wizard sends quick chat again.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: set the main account to filtered chat before login
steps.statement: UPDATE account SET chat_mode = 1 WHERE username = '{user}'

steps.name: confirm the main account is filtered
steps.query: SELECT chat_mode FROM account WHERE username = '{user}'

steps.name: make the companion account a game master
steps.pattern: Security level of \S+ set to 2

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
focus the login account field
log in
the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the main wizard key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the main wizard in the Commons
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the main client finishes loading its world interface
steps.pattern: GUI manager has shown all interactive HUDs

steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

focus the companion login account field
log in the companion
the server accepts the companion password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {companion_user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the companion is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the companion character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the companion character selection screen is on the screen
press play for the companion

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the companion key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the companion in the Commons
steps.pattern: put wizard {companion_wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: both wizards are shown to each other
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} and the (\d+) wizard\(s\) already in instance \d+ were shown to each other

steps.name: the companion client loads the zone
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {companion_wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the companion finishes loading its world interface
steps.pattern: GUI manager has shown all interactive HUDs

steps.name: open the companion chat line for the mute command
remove the slash before the companion mute command
type the timed mute command on the companion
send the timed mute command from the companion
the game server applies the timed mute
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {companion_wizard_guid} ran mute Adam AngleBane 5m, which worked

steps.name: the five minute mute is persisted
steps.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_muted m JOIN account a ON a.id = m.account_id WHERE a.username = '{user}' AND m.until > UNIX_TIMESTAMP()

steps.name: the muted main wizard sees its notice
open the filtered wizard's quick chat menu
the filtered wizard's quick chat menu
pick Yes while the filtered wizard is muted
the companion sees no muted quick chat
open the companion chat line for unmute
remove the slash before companion unmute
type the unmute command on the companion
send the unmute command from the companion
the game server removes the mute without relaying the muted line
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {companion_wizard_guid} ran unmute Adam AngleBane, which worked
steps.fail: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} sent quick chat phrase \d+, shown to \d+ other wizard\(s\)

steps.name: the muted wizard sees the unmute notice
steps.pattern: Server Message: You have been unmuted\.

steps.name: unmute did not open a mute-failed dialog
steps.pattern: GUI_MuteFailedMsg|GUI_MuteFailedTitle

steps.name: open the companion chat line after unmute
remove the slash before the companion's off-whitelist line
type a benign off-whitelist line from the open-chat companion
send the off-whitelist line
the off-whitelist line reaches the filtered main wizard
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} sent a chat line, shown to (\d+) other wizard\(s\)

steps.name: the filtered main wizard sees filtered chat
open the companion chat line for an expiring mute
remove the slash before the expiring mute
type the short mute command
send the short mute command
the game server applies the short mute
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {companion_wizard_guid} ran mute Adam AngleBane 10s, which worked

steps.name: the short mute is persisted
steps.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_muted m JOIN account a ON a.id = m.account_id WHERE a.username = '{user}' AND m.until > UNIX_TIMESTAMP()

steps.name: the short mute expires
steps.query: SELECT IF(COALESCE(MAX(m.until), 0) <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(), 1, 0) FROM account_muted m JOIN account a ON a.id = m.account_id WHERE a.username = '{user}'

steps.name: open quick chat after the mute expires
send Yes after the mute expires
the companion receives quick chat after expiry
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} sent quick chat phrase \d+, shown to (\d+) other wizard\(s\)

steps.name: the expired mute clears with a client-safe notice
steps.pattern: Server Message: You have been unmuted\.

steps.name: expiry did not open a mute-failed dialog
steps.pattern: GUI_MuteFailedMsg|GUI_MuteFailedTitle

steps.name: the companion sees post-expiry quick chat
